sample_unit: surveys of surgeon- or AI-written operative notes

links.outcome: Rated accuracy, content and organization of AI vs surgeon-written operative notes on the same cases
links.effect: AI accuracy 4.44 vs surgeon 4.33 (P = 0.512); AI content lower, 3.73 vs 4.42 (P < 0.001).
links.quote: The mean AI accuracy was not different from the mean surgeon accuracy (4.44 vs. 4.33; P = 0.512), the mean AI content was lower than the mean surgeon content (3.73 vs. 4.42; P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability of GPT-4 to generate neurosurgical operative notes from vignettes compared to human surgeons in an offline expert-review study, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
